answer_text: To troubleshoot slow Internet on Cato, start with a ping test and traceroute to compare latency when traffic passes through Cato versus bypassing the Cloud to identify sub-optimal routing. Also verify the Socket link speeds; ensure WAN and LAN are full duplex and at or above your configured site bandwidth, since these link speeds can cap throughput. If the issue might be ISP last-mile related, use Network Analytics to correlate site performance with last-mile conditions. If the problem involves Wi‑Fi, check client signal strength, as a poor Wi‑Fi connection can cause slow client performance.
